intent: Asynchronous, poll()-able DNS resolution: SResolve() starts a lookup on a detached thread (or resolves a literal IP inline) and hands back a shared SResolution both sides can safely outlive each other on.

objects.role: PENDING/RESOLVED/FAILED state machine with a self-pipe fd for poll()-based completion notification

objects.name: SResolve
objects.role: starts the lookup and returns the shared SResolution
